recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser canvas game titled `Pocket Blockstead: Craft & Survive`. Preserve a 2D sandbox survival crafting loop: a player uses a left virtual joystick to move and aim, a jump button to hop, and a main action button to mine targeted blocks, place selected materials, or attack nearby hopping enemies. The procedural tile world has grass/dirt/stone/wood/leaves/coal/gold/torches/bedrock, resource drops, a 20-slot inventory, recipes for torches/tools, a day/night clock, hearts, enemy damage, and respawn instead of a hard game over.

Present it as a cozy Minecraft-like mobile maker fantasy: square block textures, a blocky maker avatar, creeperslime hazards, Maker Pack inventory, Craft Bench modal, Block Clock HUD, chunky pixel fonts, voxel sky, cube clouds, layered strata, lantern glows, and short readable touch-friendly instructions. Keep mechanics intact; transform only visuals, labels, feedback, and scene ownership.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first 2D canvas sandbox survival/crafting platformer.
- objective: explore procedural tile terrain, mine blocks, collect drops, place blocks, craft tools/torches, and survive hostile mobs during the day/night loop.
- input model: virtual joystick for movement/aiming, jump button, mine/place/action button, inventory modal button, crafting modal button, native start/close clicks.
- core loop: spawn in terrain, move/jump, aim at nearby tile, hold action to mine or place selected material, collect drops, manage inventory, craft, avoid/attack enemies, continue after respawn.
- fail/friction state: hostile enemy contact removes hearts; zero hearts restores health, resets spawn/time/enemies, and continues play.

## Protected Mechanics
- Tile size, world dimensions, terrain generation, gravity, jump velocity, camera follow, raycast reach, collision rules, mining hardness, item drops, recipes, enemy spawn/attack, health and respawn semantics.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
- Title, HUD vocabulary, start instructions, feedback text, modal labels, CSS theme, canvas drawing of background/blocks/player/enemies/particles/cursor, fonts, and non-blocking audio/feedback polish.

## Remix Blueprint
`Pocket Blockstead: Craft & Survive` preserves the sandbox mining/crafting survival loop while giving it a coherent Minecraft-inspired mobile portrait identity: a blocky maker explores a cozy procedural blockstead, gathers visible strata, builds with collected blocks, crafts at a bench, and survives creeperslime night pressure. The rebuild uses inline Canvas/CSS/JS for a stable single-file canonical surface and keeps `index_old.html` as reference-only evidence.
